---
title: "Overall survival with unrestricted follow-up — non-PH fitting"
subtitle: "Supporting time-varying treatment-effect analysis using five imputations"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

The existing non-proportional-hazards supporting model is fitted using the
unrestricted death or censoring time and the same five completed datasets as
the unrestricted proportional-hazards model.

```{r}
#| label: fit-supporting-os-unrestricted-nph
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rstanarm)

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
indices <- config$imputation$supporting$indices
imputations <- readRDS(here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "os-unrestricted", "imputations.rds"
))
model_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "os-unrestricted-nph", "models"
)
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (index in indices) {
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  if (!force && file.exists(model_path)) next

  completed_data <- mice::complete(imputations, index) |>
    dplyr::mutate(mgps = factor(mgps, levels = 0:2))

  # A participant censored on the randomization day cannot contribute to the
  # survival likelihood, but remains in the completed dataset.
  fitting_data <- completed_data |>
    dplyr::filter_out(survival_time_days_unrestricted == 0)

  model <- rstanarm::stan_surv(
    formula = survival::Surv(
      survival_time_days_unrestricted,
      status_death_unrestricted
    ) ~ tve(tx, df = 3, degree = 3) +
      ecog_binary + stage_binary + lung + mgps,
    data = fitting_data,
    chains = 4L,
    iter = 1000L,
    warmup = 500L,
    cores = 4L,
    basehaz = "ms",
    basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
    seed = analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index, offset = 900L)
  )

  saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
}
```
